title: Shoggoth wall art — round 05: full-piece composition (in-house renders)
notes: 13 cards, ALL rendered in-house from the real parametric geometry (no Canva; these are the actual 914 mm piece at composition resolution, Gate-2 surface vocabulary + locked shader). Each variant changes ONE axis vs the hero — vote the axes: (a) mask carved-serene vs flat-graphic smiley (hero vs v1), (b) maw vs no maw (hero vs v2), (c) radial sprawl vs diagonal sweep (hero vs v3), (d) shelf arrangement A vs B (hero vs v4). CAD's blunt self-assessment: body reads emblem-like starburst at wall distance, not yet c01's fleshy sprawl; mask is too focal for the not-a-centerpiece rule; body-vocabulary refinement continues next round whatever you pick — your axis verdicts steer it. Engineering numbers are composition proxies; full print validation happens at print resolution after your pick.

cards.title: HERO — front, wall distance
cards.rationale: Baseline: carved-serene mask + maw, radial sprawl, shelves A (upper-L, R, lower-L). Judge the overall silhouette and wall presence.

cards.title: HERO — three-quarter
cards.rationale: Depth variance and shelf protrusion read best here. Buttress limb at lower left.

cards.title: HERO — raking close-up on mask
cards.rationale: Gate-2 surface at close range: grain, crevice shading, recessed serene face in its bone bezel. CAD rates this the strongest image.

cards.title: HERO — side profile
cards.rationale: Relief depth profile: flat back, bas-to-mid body, shelves at 200-290 mm. Is the protrusion variance enough?

cards.title: V1 — flat-graphic smiley mask, front
cards.rationale: Axis (a): the r04 m07 graphic-smiley direction on the real body. CAD flags it reading like a sticker — do you agree?

cards.title: V1 — flat-graphic smiley, three-quarter
cards.rationale: Axis (a) at an angle: does the flat disc hold up off-axis, or does carved-serene win?

cards.title: V2 — mask only, no maw, front
cards.rationale: Axis (b): drops the sketch's second mouth. CAD finds this calmer and cleaner than the hero. Keep the maw or not?

cards.title: V2 — no maw, three-quarter
cards.rationale: Axis (b) at an angle: body mass without the dark void and fibre teeth.

cards.title: V3 — diagonal sweep, front
cards.rationale: Axis (c): body rotated 38°, elongated, whips trailing up-right/down-left. Biggest silhouette change of the set.

cards.title: V3 — diagonal sweep, three-quarter
cards.rationale: Axis (c) at an angle. Note: currently 4-5 mm over the 914 mm box; trivially clipped at print res if you pick it.

cards.title: V4 — shelf arrangement B, front
cards.rationale: Axis (d): left-mid, right-upper, right-lower (longest carries the buttress). CAD says B breaks the wing-symmetry of A — better horrific asymmetry.

cards.title: V4 — shelves B, three-quarter
cards.rationale: Axis (d) at an angle: shelf heights 210/240/280 mm protrusion.

cards.title: SHEET — all five vs the c01 reference
cards.rationale: Side-by-side: hero + 4 variants + the c01 you loved. The gap to c01's fleshy sprawl is the next body-refinement target; this card is for calibration, vote the gap's severity.
